name: cix
description: Semantic code search and navigation for Cowork and Claude Desktop, backed by a cix server.
long_description: Exposes a running cix server's semantic code index as MCP tools. The model is server-centric: this connection talks to the cix SERVER, which may hold many indexed repositories — not a single project, and nothing is inferred from a working directory. Discover what's indexed (workspaces / projects), do broad cross-repository research with workspace search, or drill into one repo by passing its host_path explicitly. This is the recommended way to use cix inside Cowork, which does not load Claude Code plugins. The bundled `cix` binary runs as a stdio MCP server (`cix mcp`) and talks to your cix server over HTTP with a Bearer key.

tools.name: cix_list_servers
tools.description: List the cix servers this connection can reach (multi-server).

tools.name: cix_list_projects
tools.description: List repositories indexed by the cix server.

tools.name: cix_list_workspace_projects
tools.description: List the repositories in a workspace.

tools.name: cix_workspace_search
tools.description: Semantic search across all repositories in a workspace.

tools.name: cix_search
tools.description: Semantic code search within one repository (explicit project).

tools.name: cix_references
tools.description: Find references to a symbol (metadata only).

tools.name: cix_summary
tools.description: Project overview: languages, top dirs, key symbols.

server_url.title: cix server URL
server_url.description: Base URL of your cix server (e.g. http://localhost:21847 or your tunnel URL). Leave blank to use the server configured in ~/.cix/config.yaml.

api_key.title: cix API key
api_key.description: Bearer API key for the cix server. Leave blank to use the key in ~/.cix/config.yaml.
